name: RMS Error Indicator at Hospital Station
description: The hospital station stacklight illuminates red, yellow, and green simultaneously to indicate an RMS error.

name: Fault Indicator at Hospital Station
description: A flashing red stacklight at the hospital station indicates a fault condition.

name: AGV Error Code Display
description: The AGV Status screen displays any error codes that an AGV is currently experiencing.

name: Tipper Alarms on Operator Station HMI
description: Tipper alarms are displayed on the Operator Station HMI Visu_Alarm screen with timestamps.

name: Alarm Table Structure
description: Alarms are defined using a table with columns for Text List, ID, Alarm Text, Cause, Controller Response, and Corrective Action.

name: Left Tipper Alarm Group
description: The Left Tipper has a dedicated alarm group (AlarmGroup_Helix_LeftTipper) with specific alarms for E-Stop, cycle states, faults, and operator requests.

name: Right Tipper Alarm Group
description: The Right Tipper has a dedicated alarm group (AlarmGroup_Helix_RightTipper) mirroring the Left Tipper's alarms for E-Stop, cycle states, and faults.

name: Hospital Request Alarm
description: A 'Hospital Request' alarm (ID 18 for Left Tipper) is generated when a manual or automatic request is made to send a tote to the hospital for diagnosis.

name: Tipper Cycle Stop Alarm
description: A 'Tipper Cycle Stopped' alarm (ID 13) indicates the operator station is in a Cycle Stopped state, requiring a CYCLE START or RESET command.

name: Tipper Axis Hard Stop Fault
description: A fault is registered if a tipper axis is pushed to its hard stop during jogging.

name: Non-Recoverable Fault: AGV Stuck
description: A non-recoverable fault indicating an AGV remains at the tipper after tote-tipping is complete, likely due to a communication issue.

name: AGV Bump Fault Exception Codes
description: Two exception codes are defined for AGV 'Bump' faults: 21057 (Robot front collision bar triggers) and 21060 (The robot triggers the obstacle avoidance).

name: Obstacle reporting and alarm visibility in RMS
description: When an AGV detects an obstacle through its physical hardware, the condition is reported to RMS, which generates an alarm code visible on the RMS screen.

name: AGB low-battery red flashing indication
description: When an AGB battery level goes under 30%, the AGB will start flashing red.

name: Bottom section filtered to AGVs with errors
description: The bottom section of the Overall System AGV Status view is dedicated to AGVs with errors.

name: Error-focused section of AGV status popup
description: The lower portion of the AGV status popup is reserved for AGVs with errors and provides additional detail for those cases.

name: Tote Error field reference
description: The Tote Task interface includes a Tote Error field for tote-related error visibility.

name: Active AGV faults display on Overall System RMS
description: The Overall System RMS page includes a display area for active AGV faults on the right side of the page.

name: AGV Error Reference Model
description: The AGV Error model table stores error codes and descriptions and classifies errors as critical or non-critical for metric purposes.

name: AGV Active Error and Error Activity Records
description: The AGV Active Error Database model records AGV errors currently in the system, while resolved or removed errors are archived to AGV Error Activity.

name: System Error Definition table
description: The System Error Definition table stores the definitions of system errors.

name: AGV and System Error Alert
description: The AGV status display includes an error alert that is set to true when an AGV-related or system error is present and surfaces the alert in the HMI.
